newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Thailand's Sinn Bualuang to launch 6 bln yen FRN.
newsitem.headline: Thailand's Sinn Bualuang to launch 6 bln yen FRN.

text.p: Thailand's Sinn Bualuang Co Ltd will launch a 6.0 billion yen floating rate note issue on Wednesday, arranger Societe Generale Asia said on Tuesday.
Sinn Bualuang, which was established by the Bangkok Bank, engages in leasing, servicing and other financial activities.
The notes carry a final maturity of five years but can be put or called annually.
With fees, the all-in return for top tier managers is around 140 basis points.
The other arrangers are Overseas Union Bank, Sakura Finance Asia Shinhan Finance and Tokai Asia.
